summary: Verified all 3 new features on DukanSaathi demo PWA at phone viewport 414x850: (1) input font-size 16px + viewport maximum-scale=1, (2) customer/supplier autocomplete with existing options + Add-new (also creates customer on commit), (3) store-credit redemption on sale and store-credit accrual from returns. All PASS with concrete DOM/localStorage evidence.
critical_code_review_comments: commitDraft() correctly decreases customer.storeCredit by sum of payments with mode==='credit' and increases it when a return settlement === 'store_credit'. Guarded with Math.max(0, ...) to avoid negatives.

index.css @layer base rule forces font-size:16px !important on input:not([type=checkbox|radio]), select, textarea — verified computed style is exactly 16px across 5 different controls on 4 pages, preventing iOS focus-zoom.
CustomerSearch shows existing matches with udhari/credit chips and an 'Add new' entry (hidden when exact name match exists) — matches the ProductSearch UX pattern.
resolveCustomer auto-creates a customer when no fuzzy match exists — verified 'Naveen Kumar' is created with totalPending:0, storeCredit:0.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 sales during test: (a) Ramesh Traders low-value bill fully covered by store credit (₹306.8), (b) Naveen Kumar new-customer bill (₹531 full cash). Also created 1 return crediting Ramesh with ₹260 store credit. Data persists per browser localStorage; no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reset seed state, page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()") then reload — c2 store credit re-seeds to 2000. window.open is monkey-patched to record blob URL calls when needed.
